Class SshTtyConnector

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshTtyConnector
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.jediterm.terminal.TtyConnector
public class SshTtyConnector extends Object implements com.jediterm.terminal.TtyConnector
The SshTtyConnector connects JediTerm, the terminal widget, to an Apache MINA SSHD shell channel. Keyboard bytes are written to the channel's inverted standard input. Remote output is read from the channel's inverted standard output. AMWP is the framed protocol carried on that same channel. An Init reply that is not a valid 0xAE frame leaves the connector in raw mode. In AMWP mode, JediTerm sees only Scope T octets. Scope T is the terminal channel inside an AMWP frame. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#SshTtyConnector // @aa-sdd G-07 G-18 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

    • SshTtyConnector

      public SshTtyConnector(String name, org.apache.sshd.client.SshClient client, org.apache.sshd.client.session.ClientSession session, org.apache.sshd.client.channel.ChannelShell channel)
      The constructor stores the open shell and prepares a raw UTF-8 reader on its inverted output. AMWP is off until tryAmwpInit() succeeds. The held-frame list starts empty.
      Parameters:
      name - The name is the display name, usually the user, the remote address, and the port.
      client - The client is the started Apache MINA SSHD client.
      session - The session is the authenticated SSH session.
      channel - The channel is the open shell channel that uses inverted streams.

  • Method Details

    • tryAmwpInit

      public void tryAmwpInit()
      The method sends a client Init frame and switches to AMWP only when a valid reply arrives. The reply magic byte is 0xAE. A timeout, a closed stream, or any other failure leaves a raw PTY reader. A PTY is the remote terminal allocated for the shell. The method writes an Init frame on Scope A. The method waits up to the Init wait for the first byte. A timeout or a negative read installs a raw reader on the peeked stream and returns. A first byte that is not magic is pushed back onto that raw stream. A magic byte is completed into a header. A header read that ends early installs the raw reader and returns. An Init frame stores session facts from AmwpToon.decodeFacts(byte[]). An empty Init body is not reported as facts. An Init frame or a Data frame calls enterMux(). A Scope T payload on that first frame is queued for JediTerm. Any other parsed type is not treated as a successful handshake. An exception clears the AMWP flag and leaves the raw reader. // @aa-sdd G-18 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

    • enterMux

      private void enterMux()
      The method switches JediTerm reads onto the Scope T queue. The reader becomes a SshTtyConnector.ScopeTStream. A daemon thread named aetheris-amwp-demux runs demuxLoop(). A daemon timer named aetheris-amwp-ka calls sendKeepalive() on the keepalive interval.

    • demuxLoop

      private void demuxLoop()
      The method reads AMWP frames until the stream ends or the connector closes. A null frame ends the loop. A keepalive frame is skipped. A Scope T frame with a payload is passed to queueScopeT(byte[]). Every other frame is passed to deliverOrHold(AmwpFrame). An exception notifies the listener with onAmwpClosed when a listener is stored and the connector is not already closed. Bytes still held for a split OSC sequence are queued after the loop. An empty chunk is queued so SshTtyConnector.ScopeTStream can finish.

    • queueScopeT

      private void queueScopeT(byte[] chunk) throws InterruptedException
      The method queues Scope T bytes after the private select-model OSC sequence is removed. The sequence opens with ESC ] 7 7 7 ; select-model ; and ends at BEL. Bytes before that sequence are painted to JediTerm. A matching sequence is not painted. The text before the first semicolon is the model id. The text after that semicolon is the think string. Both strings are passed to notifyConsoleModel(String, String). A prefix cut off at the end of the chunk is held. A full opening with no BEL is held when the pending tail is at most 256 bytes. A longer unfinished tail is painted instead of held. A non-matching escape byte is painted and the scan continues. Painted bytes are placed on the Scope T queue. The queue put can throw InterruptedException while the terminal queue is closing.
      Parameters:
      chunk - The chunk is one Scope T payload.
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - The exception is thrown when the queue put is interrupted.

    • sendKeepalive

      private void sendKeepalive()
      The method writes an AMWP keepalive on Scope A. The method returns when AMWP is off. The method returns when the connector is not connected. A write failure is ignored. The next read reports a dead channel.

    • setAmwpListener

      public void setAmwpListener(AmwpClientListener listener)
      The method stores the Scope A listener. A null listener holds later frames on this session. A non-null listener receives every frame that was held while it was away. Those held frames are cleared before they are delivered.
      Parameters:
      listener - The listener is the Scope A sink, or null to hold frames.

    • deliverOrHold

      private void deliverOrHold(AmwpFrame frame)
      The method delivers one Scope A frame, or holds it until a listener is stored. A missing listener appends the frame when fewer than 64 frames are held. A frame past that cap is dropped. A stored listener receives the frame outside the lock.
      Parameters:
      frame - The frame is a non-keepalive frame that is not on Scope T.

      public void writeAmwp(int type, byte[] payload) throws IOException
      The method writes one Scope A frame. The channel is the Scope A channel. Raw mode does not write the frame. Raw mode throws IOException.
      Parameters:
      type - The type is the AMWP frame type.
      payload - The payload is the frame body.

    • writeAmwp

      public void writeAmwp(int channel, int type, byte[] payload) throws IOException
      The method writes one AMWP frame on the given channel. Scope A execute stays on channel 0x0002. Tool frames use channel 0x0004. The method throws IOException with the text AMWP not negotiated when AMWP is off. The write is serialized on the write lock.
      Parameters:
      channel - The channel is the AMWP channel number.
      type - The type is the AMWP frame type.
      payload - The payload is the frame body.
      Throws:
      IOException - The exception is thrown when AMWP is off or the write fails.

    • close

      public void close()
      The method closes the connector once. A second call returns immediately. The keepalive timer is cancelled when one exists. An empty chunk is queued so a blocked Scope T read can finish. The demux thread is interrupted when it exists. closeQuietly() then closes the channel, the session, and the client.
      Specified by:
      close in interface com.jediterm.terminal.TtyConnector

    • closeQuietly

      private void closeQuietly()
      The method closes the channel, the session, the client, the reader, and the inverted input. Each close swallows its own error. The client is stopped rather than closed.
